pub type Raw
pub enum Evidence
  Verified
  Claimed
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum ResourceCallOutcome
  Ok
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  Invalid
  Unknown
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum AcquireOutcome
  Acquired
  Insufficient
  HoldersRefused
  NotPermitted
  Unavailable
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum YieldAnswer
  Yielded
  Refused
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum ProcessBindOutcome
  Bound
  Unverifiable
  Refused
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const INTERNAL: &str
  pub const INVALID_REQUEST: &str
  pub const CALLER_REFUSED: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_RESOURCE: &str
  pub const POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: &str
  pub const FORBIDDEN: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 12]
pub const KNOWN_RESOURCES: [&str; 3]
pub const RESOURCE_ERROR_CODES: [&str; 6]
pub struct Holder
  program: String
  account: String
  amount: i64
  evidence: Evidence
  lease: String
  grant: String
  since: String
  detail: String
pub struct ResourceState
  resource: String
  capacity: i64
  held: i64
  holders: Vec<Holder>
  observed: String
  instrument: String
pub struct HoldersResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  state: Option<ResourceState>
pub struct ResourceList
  resources: Vec<String>
  observed: String
pub struct ResourcesResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  list: Option<ResourceList>
pub struct Lease
  id: String
  resource: String
  amount: i64
  since: String
  renew_by: String
pub struct YieldRecord
  holder: String
  amount: i64
  answer: String
  took_ms: i64
pub struct AcquireResult
  outcome: AcquireOutcome
  lease: Option<Lease>
  asked: Vec<YieldRecord>
pub struct YieldRequest
  id: String
  resource: String
  amount: i64
  reason: String
  at: String
  lease: String
pub struct YieldPage
  requests: Vec<YieldRequest>
  next: String
pub struct ObserveResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  page: Option<YieldPage>
pub struct AnswerResult
  recorded: bool
pub struct AnswerCallResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  answer: Option<AnswerResult>
pub struct LeaseChange
  applied: bool
  lease: Option<Lease>
pub struct LeaseChangeResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  change: Option<LeaseChange>
pub struct ProcessBindResult
  outcome: ProcessBindOutcome
pub fn encode(v: &ResourceState) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<ResourceState, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait Table
  type Error
  fn resources(&self) -> Result<ResourcesResult, Self::Error>
  fn holders(&self, resource: String, fresh: bool) -> Result<HoldersResult, Self::Error>
pub struct TableClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Leases
  type Error
  fn acquire(&self, resource: String, amount: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<AcquireResult, Self::Error>
  fn renew(&self, lease: String) -> Result<LeaseChangeResult, Self::Error>
  fn release(&self, lease: String) -> Result<LeaseChangeResult, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, cursor: String, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<ObserveResult, Self::Error>
  fn answer(&self, request: String, answer: YieldAnswer, reason: String) -> Result<AnswerCallResult, Self::Error>
  fn bind_process(&self, lease: String, pid: i64) -> Result<ProcessBindResult, Self::Error>
pub struct LeasesClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub mod internal
  pub fn micros_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
  pub fn wide_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
